Migrated from canardlapin/scalafim Mote bd-01KY51743TJET8YEPKT8PQBVHA on 2026-08-01 after HalfFlow ownership moved to canardlapin/reframe4s.
Source status: closed. Source created_at: 2026-07-22T13:46:05.818881Z.

Replace sampled inverse-pair authority only in the experimental HalfFlow-CC lane while retaining exact affine factors and the old engine as control.

Acceptance gate:
- Each midpoint arm stores an exact affine and one forward W-to-W residual; paired h+ and h- increments advance the two arms with verified composition order and half-step signs.
- No sampled backward residual is authoritative optimization state. Any inverse cache is named approximate, measured, refreshable, and excluded from anatomical acceptance.
- Damping changes only after objective/model observations; stepScale changes only after incremental or accumulated Jacobian failures; squaring depth changes only after paired-flow integration error. Unit tests perturb each failure class and prove the other two controls remain unchanged.
- Typed geometry verdicts distinguish incremental from accumulated Jacobian failures. These are the only hard anatomical rejection reasons.
- Typed numerical verdicts request deeper integration or inverse-cache refresh without inflating damping.
- Level transitions have an explicit damping-reset policy; damping, stepScale, squarings, and retry budgets are capped and fully traced.
- Export inversion refines residual inverses multiresolution, composes exact affine inverses, reports interior percentile and maximum error, and either meets configured physical/voxel tolerances or returns a typed failure.
- Identity, composition, swap, boundary, positive-Jacobian, and export-round-trip contracts pass on JVM and Scala.js.
set.title: HalfFlow-CC G3: forward midpoint state, controllers, and export contract
